programme.title: Computer Science BSc (UCAS G400)
programme.degree: BSc (Hons) Computer Science, UCAS G400, 3 years full-time; TMUA admissions test required (unless contextual offer)
programme.notes: The kb list row has no official_domain; warwick.ac.uk is the university's own domain (the scholarship portal is ugscholarships.warwick.ac.uk).

english.quote: Band A 6.0 including minimum 5.5 in each component
english.notes: Course page (2027 entry): 'English language requirements This course requires: Band A'. The band table on the requirements page is the 2026-entry table ('Acceptable when taken on or after 1 September 2024 for September 2026 entry only'); the 2027 table is not yet published. IELTS must be one sitting; tests within two years and one month of the start.

gpa.notes: No GPA. Typical offer A-level A*A*A including A* in Mathematics (contextual A*AA); TMUA required (course page).

deadline.notes: No 2027 date on the CS pages. The Department of Computer Science FAQ says 'Equal consideration will be given to all applications received by the UCAS deadline of 14th January' (https://warwick.ac.uk/fac/sci/dcs/admissions/undergraduate/faqs/) - no year printed, and 14 January was the 2026-entry UCAS date; the university FAQ also cites 'the application equal consideration date of 14 January 2026'. Not recorded as the 2027 deadline.

tuition.notes: Columns 2025-26, 2026-27, 2027-28 on the UG Overseas Fees page; £37,310 is 2027-28 (annual fee).

scholarship_exists.quote: Warwick Undergraduate Global Excellence Scholarship 2026/2027 Eligibility To be classed as overseas for fees purposes
scholarship_exists.notes: Published for 2026/27 entry only (applied before 14 Jan 2026, start Autumn 2026, self-funded); no 2027/28 round published yet. Fee-discount awards (full, half, 25% fee) - competitive.

scholarship_international.quote: Warwick Undergraduate Global Excellence Scholarship 2026/2027 Eligibility To be classed as overseas for fees purposes
scholarship_international.notes: Restricted to overseas fee status applicants; 2026/27 cycle.
